value.rationale: Solves a natural infinite-dimensional spectral optimization for a full family of dimension-dependent geodesic samplers, with exact sharp d^-1 contraction, two optimal angles, strict harmonic equality classification, and optimal powers. Not a generic textbook substitution; one nontrivial fourth-moment bound excludes infinitely many sectors.
